claims.exact_statement: For every finite Boolean f:{0,1}^n->{-1,+1} and every integer m>=3, G_m(x,z)=f(x)*b_(n+m)(x,z), with b_N=-1 exactly on the radius-one Hamming ball, has at least three residual rows for every coordinate block B with 2<=|B|<=n+m-1. Thus G_m admits no proper nonsingleton single-Boolean-output block compression. With f fixed and m->infinity, H(G_m)->H(f) and I(G_m)->I(f); ratios converge when f is nonconstant. For every fixed finite C>=0, FEI(C) for all such block-prime functions is equivalent to full FEI(C), without changing C.

m>=3; original f arbitrary, including constants and dummies.

claims.exact_statement: For every n>=3 let b_n(x)=-1 exactly on the Hamming ball of radius one on the uniform n-bit cube. Every proper coordinate block B with2<=|B|<=n-1 has EXACTLY three distinct residual truth-table rows, so it admits no Boolean one-output summary, even with all outside bits raw. Consequently every disjoint proper Boolean-core decomposition of b_n has only singleton cores. For every real K>=0 and kappa>=0, each such decomposition has zero weighted inner entropy/hull savings and bank C+kappa I+sum q rho_K=H(b_n)+kappa I(b_n). The exact spectrum is bhat(empty)=1-2(n+1)/2^n and bhat(S)=-2(n+1-2|S|)/2^n for nonempty S; I=2n(n-1)/2^n and H/I tends to4. Hence the optimized proper-partition bank price tends to4+kappa; at rational kappa3 it tends to7. Exact certificates additionally give H(b_16)>3I and H(b_32)>(7/2)I. This obstructs a universal positive initial entropy discount from proper disjoint Boolean decompositions, not FEI: H/I has finite limit4 and the universal initial price remains unpaid. In addition H(b_n)<5I(b_n) for all n>=3, so this bank is below(5+kappa)I on the entire family; zero discount does not mean the family itself is unpaid.
hypotheses: Uniform physical bits and complete squared Fourier Shannon entropy in bits; n>=3.
A proper partition covers all physical variables by disjoint nonempty coordinate blocks, none equal to the whole domain; each core has one Boolean output and the outer Boolean gate is arbitrary.
K>=0 and rho_K is the full physical stopping hull of(H-KI)_+ at that same K; constants/dummies retain their full branches.
No overlapping supports, multiple-output summaries, arbitrary linear changes of physical variables, decomposition transfers, or universal initial payment are inferred.
No FEI disproof or universal bank upper bound is claimed; fixed-family finite audits validate the separately proved all-dimensional formulas.
